PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Gentle postpartum recovery and gradual return to activity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Early Recovery" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Gentle Mobility & Walking":
        warmup:
          walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_cat_cow 2x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          seated_shoulder_circles 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          standing_heel_raises 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 20m "Gentle Mobility & Walking":
        warmup:
          walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_cat_cow 2x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          seated_shoulder_circles 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          standing_heel_raises 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Gentle Mobility & Walking":
        warmup:
          walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_cat_cow 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          seated_shoulder_circles 2x12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          standing_heel_raises 2x12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 20m "Gentle Mobility & Walking":
        warmup:
          walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_cat_cow 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          seated_shoulder_circles 2x12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          standing_heel_raises 2x12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m

  PHASE "Phase 2: Gentle Progression" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Mobility & Gentle Strength":
        warmup:
          walk 7m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_cat_cow 2x12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          standing_heel_raises 3x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          wall_pushups 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 25m "Mobility & Gentle Strength":
        warmup:
          walk 7m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_cat_cow 2x12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          standing_heel_raises 3x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          wall_pushups 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:

    WEEK 4:

        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m

  PHASE "Phase 3: Foundation Building" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Mobility & Bodyweight Strength":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          standing_heel_raises 3x15 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          wall_pushups 3x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          sit_to_stand 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 30m "Mobility & Bodyweight Strength":
